about.text: The sweets of eastern India and Bangladesh made from chhena kneaded smooth: rolled into balls and cooked in syrup as rasgulla, soaked in sweetened, thickened milk as rasmalai, or cooked with sugar and shaped as sandesh.

sources.text: The photograph, its author and its licence, from its page.

how.text: Chhena is kneaded smooth, with a little binder for some sweets, and shaped. It is then cooked in syrup (rasgulla), cooked dry with sugar (sandesh) or soaked in thickened milk (rasmalai).
